mn78:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn78:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Uggāhamāno paribbājako Samaṇamaṇḍikāputto samayappavādake tindukācīre ekasālake Mallikāya ārāme paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ timattehi paribbājakasatehi.
mn78:2.1: Atha kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati Sāvatthiyā nikkhami divādivassa Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
mn78:2.2: Atha kho Pañcakaṅgassa thapatissa etad ahosi:
mn78:2.7: Yannūnāhaṃ yena samayappavādako tindukācīro ekasālako Mallikāya ārāmo yena Uggāhamāno paribbājako Samaṇamaṇḍikāputto ten' upasaṃkameyyan ti.
mn78:2.8: Atha kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati yena samayappavādako tindukācīro ekasālako Mallikāya ārāmo, ten' upasaṃkami.
mn78:3.1: Tena kho pana samayena Uggāhamāno paribbājako Samaṇamaṇḍikāputto mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ nisinno hoti unnādiniyā uccāsaddāya mahāsaddāya anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentiyā, seyyathīdaṃ:
mn78:3.2: rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mahāmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ yānakathaṃ gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lokakkhāyikaṃ samuddakkhāyikaṃ itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā.
mn78:3.3: Addasā kho Uggāhamāno paribbājako Samaṇamaṇḍikāputto Pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ;
mn78:3.5: Appasaddā bhonto hontu; mā bhonto saddam akattha;
mn78:3.6: ayaṃ samaṇassa Gotamassa sāvako āgacchati, Pañcakaṅgo thapati.
mn78:3.7: Yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa Gotamassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā Sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti, ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro Pañcakaṅgo thapati.
mn78:3.8: Appasaddakāmā kho pana te āyasmanto appasaddavinītā appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino,
mn78:3.9: app' eva nāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṃkamitabbaṃ maññeyyāti.
mn78:3.10: Atha kho te paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
mn78:4.1: Atha kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati yena Uggāhamāno paribbājako Samaṇamaṇḍikāputto, ten' upasaṃkami; upasaṃkamitvā Uggāhamānena paribbājakena Samaṇamaṇḍikāputtena saddhiṃ sammodi;
mn78:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ Uggāhamāno paribbājako Samaṇamaṇḍikāputto etad avoca:
mn78:5.1: Catuhi kho ahaṃ, thapati, dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ.
mn78:5.3: Idha, thapati, na kāyena pāpakaṃ kammaṃ karoti, na pāpikaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati, na pāpakaṃ saṃkappaṃ saṃkappeti, na pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvati.
mn78:5.4: Imehi kho ahaṃ, thapati, catuhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhan ti.
mn78:6.1: Atha kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati Uggāhamānassa paribbājakassa Samaṇamaṇḍikāputtassa bhāsitaṃ n' eva abhinandi nappaṭikkosi;
mn78:6.3: Bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmīti.
mn78:7.1: Atha kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami; upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn78:7.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati, yāvatako ahosi Uggāhamānena paribbājakena Samaṇamaṇḍikāputtena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ Bhagavato ārocesi.
mn78:8.1: Evaṃ vutte, Bhagavā Pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ etad avoca:--
mn78:8.2: Evaṃ sante kho, thapati, daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako sampannakusalo bhavissati paramakusalo uttamapattipatto samaṇo ayojjho, yathā Uggāhamānassa paribbājakassa Samaṇamaṇḍikāputtassa vacanaṃ.
mn78:8.3: Daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa kāyo ti pi na hoti; kuto pana kāyena pāpakaṃ kammaṃ karissati, aññatra phanditamattā.
mn78:8.4: Daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa vācā ti pi na hoti; kuto pana pāpikaṃ vācaṃ bhāssisati, aññatra roditamattā.
mn78:8.5: Daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa saṃkappo ti pi na hoti; kuto pana pāpakaṃ saṃkappaṃ saṃkappissati, aññatra vikujjitamattā.
mn78:8.6: Daharassa hi, thapati, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa ājīvo ti pi na hoti; kuto pana pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvissati, aññatra mātutthaññā.
mn78:8.7: Evaṃ sante kho, thapati, daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako sampannakusalo bhavissati paramakusalo uttamapattipatto samaṇo ayojjho, yathā Uggāhamānassa paribbājakassa Samaṇamaṇḍikāputtassa vacanaṃ.
mn78:8.8: Catuhi kho ahaṃ, thapati, dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi na c' eva sampannakusalaṃ na paramakusalaṃ na uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ, api c' imaṃ daharaṃ kumāraṃ mandaṃ uttānaseyyakaṃ samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati.
mn78:8.10: Idha, thapati, na kāyena pāpakaṃ kammaṃ karoti, na pāpikaṃ vācam bhāsati, na pāpakaṃ saṃkappaṃ saṃkappeti, na pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvati.
mn78:8.11: Imehi kho ahaṃ, thapati, catuhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi na c' eva sampannakusalaṃ na paramakusalaṃ na uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ, api c' imaṃ daharaṃ kumāraṃ mandaṃ uttānaseyyakaṃ samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati.
mn78:9.1: Dasahi kho ahaṃ, thapati, dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ.
mn78:9.8: Evaṃ - paṭipanno akusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti
mn78:9.16: Evaṃ-paṭipanno kusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti
mn78:9.24: Evaṃ paṭipanno akusalānaṃ saṃkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti
mn78:9.32: Evaṃ paṭipanno kusalānaṃ saṃkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti
mn78:10.2: Akusalaṃ kāyakammaṃ, akusalaṃ vacīkammaṃ, pāpako ājīvo, --
mn78:10.8: Cittam pi hi bahu anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ
mn78:10.9: sacittaṃ sarāgaṃ sadosaṃ samohaṃ; itosamuṭṭhānā akusalasīlā.
mn78:10.10: Ime ca, thapati, akusalasīlā kuhiṃ aparisesā nirujjhanti?
mn78:10.12: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti, vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritam bhāveti, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti, micchā-ājīvaṃ pahāya sammā-ājīvena jīvikaṃ kappeti.
mn78:10.14: Kathaṃ paṭipanno ca. thapati, akusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti?
mn78:10.15: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu anupannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati;
mn78:10.16: uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati;
mn78:10.17: anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati;
mn78:10.18: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
mn78:10.19: Evaṃ paṭipanno kho, thapati, akusalānaṃ sīlānam nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn78:11.2: Kusalaṃ kāyakammaṃ, kusalaṃ vacīkammam, ājīvapārisuddhiṃ pi kho ahaṃ, thapati, sīlasmiṃ vadāmi.
mn78:11.8: Cittam pi hi bahu anekavidhaṃ nānappakārakaṃ.
mn78:11.9: Yaṃ cittaṃ vītarāgaṃ vītadosaṃ vītamohaṃ, -- itosamuṭṭhānā kusalasīlā.
mn78:11.10: Ime ca, thapati, kusalasīlā kuhiṃ aparisesā nirujjhanti?
mn78:11.12: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, no ca sīlamayo,
mn78:11.13: tañ ca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti; yatth' assa te kusalasīlā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
mn78:11.14: Kathaṃ paṭipanno ca, thapati, kusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti?
mn78:11.15: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati;
mn78:11.18: uppannānam kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
mn78:11.19: Evaṃ paṭipanno kho, thapati, kusalānaṃ sīlānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn78:12.8: Saññā pi hi bahu anekavidhā nānappakārikā,
mn78:12.11: Ime ca, thapati, akusalasaṃkappā kuhiṃ aparisesā nirujjhanti?
mn78:12.13: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi -- paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
mn78:12.15: Kathaṃ paṭipanno ca, thapati, akusalānaṃ saṃkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti?
mn78:12.16: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati;
mn78:12.19: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya, bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā, chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
mn78:12.20: Evaṃ paṭipanno kho, thapati, akusalānaṃ saṃkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn78:13.8: Saññā pi hi bahu anekavidhā nānappakārikā,
mn78:13.11: Ime ca, thapati, kusalasaṃkappā kuhiṃ aparisesā nirujjhanti?
mn78:13.13: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā --pe-- dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn78:13.15: Kathaṃ paṭipanno ca, thapati, kusalānaṃ saṃkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti?
mn78:13.16: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati;
mn78:13.19: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiya asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
mn78:13.20: Evaṃ paṭipanno kho, thapati, kusalānaṃ saṃkappānaṃ nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti.
mn78:14.1: Katamehi cāhaṃ, thapati, dasahi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ?
mn78:14.2: Idha, thapati, bhikkhu asekhāya sammādiṭṭhiyā samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāsaṃkappena samannāgato hoti, asekhāya sammāvācāya samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammākammantena samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammā -- ājīvena samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāvāyāmena samannāgato hoti, asekhāya sammāsatiyā samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāsamādhinā samannāgato hoti, asekhena sammāñāṇena samannāgato hoti, asekhāya sammāvimuttiyā samannāgato hoti.
mn78:14.3: Imehi kho ahaṃ, thapati, dasahi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamapattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhan ti.
mn78:14.5: Attamano Pañcakaṅgo thapati Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 79.
